changeRecord.title: pinned (or partially fixed) support made fixed
changeRecord.target: support A2.0: rotation(s) rx, ry, rz fixed
changeRecord.whyItMatters: Full fixity is rarely there unless the foundation is designed for it. A base modelled as fixed takes a moment that relieves the rest of the frame: drift and the moments at the top of the columns are under-estimated, and the foundation receives a moment it may not be able to take.
changeRecord.precondition: a support with the three translations restrained and a free or sprung rotation

reference.note: the reference solution is the analysis (and design) of the perturbed model, once verified
